TestCompaction::test_delete_tombstone_gc.description: 4 nodes in 4 racks, RF=4, tombstone_gc=repair (gc_grace 5s, propagation_delay 5s). Writes 10 keys, stops node4, deletes 5 keys, flushes; a repair from node1 must fail (NodetoolError) and tombstone counts on nodes 1-3 must be unchanged (no GC after a partial repair). Then starts node4, runs repair -pr on all nodes in parallel, checks system.repair_history, runs off-strategy compaction on node4 and asserts 0 tombstones on all 4 nodes. Guards that repair-mode GC only purges after a repair covering all replicas. Skipped with tablets.
